en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a festive parade or procession on a city street, featuring people wearing traditional folk costumes. The background features a crowd of onlookers and multiple commercial signs in Cyrillic script on the facades of early-to-mid 20th-century buildings. The people in the foreground are carrying large flags or banners. The scene is lively, with a possible marching band visible on the right side.
